messages:
Priya Patel: Heads up — EdgeBox sent a big replay of offline usage this morning (~3.2M tokens across ~4k events). Some customers are showing duplicate consumption and a subset of events are mapped to legacy_customer_id that we no longer recognize. Pls triage, this will impact invoices if not handled.

marketplace-bot: ALERT: bulk-ingest-job-476 failed retries and then succeeded with 2000 events in retry-window. See logs: https://logs.internal/redwood/bulk-ingest/476 (auto)

Tom Nguyen: copying eng-infra. Do we have dedupe ids on these events? can we safely dedupe by event_id + source?

Sam Ortiz: yes payloads include event_id and dedupe_key. but some vendors (older fw) set dedupe_key to null — those are the ones getting remapped to legacy_customer_id.

Mei Chen: How many customers affected? finance needs an estimate before EOD for billing impact.

Priya Patel: rough counts from initial query: ~420 accounts show >2x usage for the replay window, ~80 accounts have mapping to legacy_customer_id, ~10 are enterprise with reserved capacity (need manual credits).

Chris (EdgeBox): Sorry — outage on our side. We rotated account IDs during the migration two weeks ago; the offline agent still stamped old_account_id in some batches. We can push a corrected file of events with original ids if that helps.

Tom Nguyen: if they can produce a file with original_event_ids we can 1) run idempotency match against ingestion table, 2) mark duplicates as ignored. But we also need to fix entitlement mapping (old_account_id -> new_customer_id). Sam, can you make a mapping pull?

Sam Ortiz: taking this. Will join with partner mapping table and the ingestion raw table. Plan: run a join on (old_account_id) -> new_customer_id mapping, update ingestion.customer_id for those rows, then run a dedupe pass where event_id present. I’ll script safe-update with a dry-run first.

Mei Chen: For billing: we need a list of impacted invoices and a proposal for credits/refunds. If credits are >$X we escalate. Also need to hold any invoices until we confirm dedupe.

Priya Patel: action items: 
- @Sam Ortiz: produce dry-run mapping + list of affected invoices by 1600 PT (owner)
- @Chris (EdgeBox): send corrected event file + manifest (sha256) by 1400 PT
- @Tom Nguyen: prepare dedupe job and rollback plan, block auto-invoice-sender for affected customer list (eng)
- @Mei Chen: draft credit proposal template and thresholds

Sam Ortiz: starting dry-run now. preliminary SQL I’ll use:
```sql
-- dry-run: identify rows to update
select r.event_id, r.source, r.payload->>\"old_account_id\" as old_acct, m.new_customer_id
from raw_ingest r
left join partner_account_map m on r.payload->>\"old_account_id\" = m.old_account_id
where r.ingest_batch = 476;
```

Priya Patel: please include counts by plan (free/paid/dedicated) in the dry-run output.

Tom Nguyen: note — there are a few events where dedupe_key is null and event_id collided. For those we might need to dedupe heuristically (timestamp + token_count + source checksum) — mark them P2.

Chris (EdgeBox): uploaded corrected file: s3://edgebox-prod/replays/476-corrected.ndjson (sha256: abc123...). We also pushed a small fix to the offline agent; new builds will be out tomorrow.

Sam Ortiz: got the file, starting idempotency compare against raw_ingest. My dry-run shows ~3.1M events are exact duplicates and ~12k look like new (likely retries that changed ids). The 12k new mostly map to legacy ids.

Mei Chen: from that dry-run, what's estimated dollar exposure?

Sam Ortiz: rough calc: duplicates ~0 (we'll ignore), 12k new => ~480K tokens billable => est $2400 charge impact (assuming $0.005/1k tokens). But enterprise reserved customers among those mean we need manual crediting.

Priya Patel: Mei, Tom, let's hold invoicing for the impacted set. Mei — can we gate invoices until Sam's final list?

Mei Chen: yes, will pause for customers flagged by the dry-run. Send list as CSV.

Tom Nguyen: I'm going to spin up the dedupe job with these safeguards:
- run in staging against a replica
- flag rows for backfill instead of hard delete (soft ignore)
- add a metric: dedupe_count, manual_override_count

Priya Patel: one more nuance — entitlements: some customers bought via our HW partner SKU with special credits. If old_account_id mapping skipped, they might not have been recognized as entitled and got charged. We need to ensure credits are applied retroactively.

Sam Ortiz: noted — will include entitlement status in the dry-run output (entitled: true/false).

Chris (EdgeBox): we can also provide a customer-to-customer contact list for the legacy IDs to help CX. happy to share mapping and contacts.

Priya Patel: CX: @Lina to prepare templated outreach. Mei — any threshold money above which we offer immediate refunds vs credits?

Mei Chen: >$1000 => refund + escalation. <=$1000 => credit by default. exceptions for reserved capacity — handle case-by-case.

Priya Patel: timeline: Sam dry-run 1500 PT, partner file by 1400 PT, dedupe job + final list by 1700 PT, invoices blocked until 1800 PT. If we hit blockers, we escalate to incident channel.

Sam Ortiz: dry-run complete. attaching sample lines from dry-run (anonymized):
```json
{"event_id":"evt_9a8b","dedupe_key":"dk_123","payload":{"old_account_id":"eb_old_001","new_customer_id":null,"tokens":120},"action":"will_update_customer"}
```

Priya Patel: thanks. Sam — once you have final list, post here and tag finance + CX. Tom — keep me posted if dedupe job needs rollback.

Tom Nguyen: will do. Starting job now in canary mode — will report counts in ~20m. :hourglass: 

marketplace-bot: JOB: dedupe-canary-1 completed. metrics: scanned=500k, deduped=485k, flagged=15k, runtime=18m (auto)

Sam Ortiz: canary results look good. Final run in 10m. writing suppression CSV for finance.

Mei Chen: received suppression CSV, will hold invoices. drafting credit notes template now.

Priya Patel: great work team. Post-mortem to follow: root cause (EdgeBox agent still using old_account_id), mitigation (partner rollout + ingestion validation), and follow-ups (pre-ingest schema validation for account_id). Assigning follow-ups after final run. :white_check_mark:
